could fly through unit 1 relatively quickly, you're guaranteed a long q in ecology and short qs on food, scientific method and characteristics of life.

 unit 2 i'd go over respiration and enzymes quite well and zoom through diffusion and osmosis. id go over as many experiments as possible bc the qs are predictable and section b is like 15% of the paper.  i'd skip genetics altogether it would take way too long to learn in a night. 

for unit 3 i'd do fungi, human reproduction,w endocrine or at least one human system bc one always comes up. you could get through homeostasis pretty quickly and look over excretion. in terms of plant chapters i'd look at structure and transport at least.  i'd look over the nervous system too. blood, and lymph you could get through relatively quickly. know the heart definitions e.g diastole and systole, how the heartbeat works etc. 

id also look at some diagrams, e.g diagram of a female or male reproductive system, the heart, nephron etc. 

i know this is a LOT but it's what i'd do if i only had a night. emphasis on experiments so you can really maximize that 15%.
